is Behavior is supposed to look for the Bark/Plhoem/Bark in the branches of the trees and "close" the branches so the Plhoem is not seen through the outside.

The closing is made by looking at the Wall Pattern of Plhoem_Sap blocks and putting bark on the side that is empty.

It works 30% of the time probably because it's very expensive computationally.
